# Hand Coded

> Hand Coded is a Barcelona studio that designs and builds interactive, immersive experiences for brands, and the technical workshop behind agencies and artists: light, sound, AI and our own tools.

## Founders
- Cyril Laurier: Co-founder. PhD in music AI, Sony CSL researcher.
- Maya Benaïnous: Co-founder. Artist and engineer, creator of Ledotron.

## Expertise
- [Imagine](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=imaginer): Concepts for brands and venues. For a brand, a launch or a venue, we invent the experience: what the audience will see, hear and set off. We write the concept, the device and the way it responds.
- [Explore](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=explorer): Consulting and workshops. You are looking for what is possible before knowing what you want. We bring your teams together, put the constraints on the table, test leads and help you pick the right one, even if it means steering the project elsewhere.
- [Build](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=fabriquer): Development and production. Real-time software, sensors, light, sound, electronics: we build the device from end to end, and run it on site or on tour.
- [Support](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=accompagner): Technical support for agencies and artists. An agency or an artist has the project in mind. We give them the tools to make it exist, from prototype to installation, without taking their place: your idea, your signature, our workshop.
- [Machine learning & our own AI](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=machine-learning). Systems that listen, watch and decide: emotion detection in music, real-time choices on stage, recommendation engines.
- [Real-time development](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=real-time). Software that reacts within the frame: custom engines in C++, openFrameworks, OpenGL and shaders, built to run night after night.
- [Audio processing](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=audio). Sound analysis and generation that drive light, image and motion: beat detection, spatialisation, interactive music.
- [Generative animation](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=generative). Algorithms that generate designs and animations, for LEDs, screens and projection.
- [Projection mapping](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=projection-mapping). Projection on architecture, objects and bodies, synchronised with sound and sensors.
- [Light and LED control](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=light). From a few strips to thousands of LEDs and motors, designed and driven with Ledotron, over DMX and Art-Net.
- [Tracking and sensors](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=tracking). Kinect, Leap Motion, cameras, body and brain sensors: we turn people's presence and movement into data.
- [Concept design](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=concept-design). We join the brainstorm early, suggest the technologies that serve the idea, and carry it from concept to production.
- [Sustainable thinking](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=sustainable). Sustainable design approaches in the choice of materials, energy and durability of every installation.
- [Project management](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=project-management). One team from the first sketch to the last show, with artists, agencies and brands. Around Maya and Cyril, we bring together for each project the collaborators, specialists and craftspeople it needs.
- [Our tools](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=tools). Autodesk Maya, After Effects, TouchDesigner, Photoshop, Xcode, MadMapper, Millumin, Ableton Live and our own Ledotron. C++, OpenGL, openFrameworks, Objective-C, SceneKit, Python, Max/MSP, GLSL, VST and WebGL. Ledotron, our software for creating and controlling light, can be rented or bought.
- [Hardware and protocols](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=hardware). DMX, Art-Net, OSC, Kinect 1 and 2, Leap Motion, augmented reality, iOS, Android and Arduino.
- [Immersive](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=immersive): Rooms of light, sound and data that answer the people inside them.. We design and build immersive spaces where image, light and sound are generated in real time, so the work is never the same twice. Cameras and sensors follow the visitors, live data from the climate, the music or the place feeds the content, and the room becomes a living environment rather than a…

## Studio
- [Cyril Laurier](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=cyril): Co-founder. PhD in music AI, Sony CSL researcher. · Barcelona. His PhD at the Music Technology Group of the Universitat Pompeu Fabra used machine learning to detect emotions in music. Before that, he studied acoustics, signal processing and computer science applied to music at IRCAM (ATIAM master), where he wrote a generative algorithm for automatic music…
- [Maya Benaïnous](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=maya): Co-founder. Artist and engineer, creator of Ledotron. · Barcelona. Artist and engineer, she creates immersive installations at the crossroads of ecology, technology and the senses, and has worked with real-time data since 2008. She invented a new way to work with LEDs: Ledotron. With Cyril, she signs her artworks as Mouawad + Laurier. Trained in mathematics,…
- [Stéphanie Huerre](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=stephanie): Maths, art and new technologies, sustainable design. · Barcelona. Ten years at Walt Disney Imagineering R&D, where she led a 3D AI simulation tool to study crowd flow and visitor experience in theme parks, and brought sustainable design into the process. She likes riding her bike.
- [Romain Tardy](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=romain-tardy): Visual artist. OX, S.A.T., MGNTRN, Future Ruins, TGIC. Hand Coded designed and developed his creation and control tools from 2014 to 2021.
- [Pablo Valbuena](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=pablo-valbuena): Visual artist. Kinematope, Gyrotope, Wave, Methods, Tientos al tiempo. Hand Coded designed and developed his creation and control tools from 2014 to 2020.
- [Adrien M & Claire B](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=adrien-m-claire-b): Digital arts and performance company. Mouvement de l’air, world tour.
- [Beardyman](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=beardyman-musician): Musician
- [Maotik](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=maotik): Visual artist. EKO, with Ezra, MIRA Festival 2014.
- [Ezra](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=ezra): Beatboxer, Organic Orchestra. Bionic Orchestra and EKO, with the Organic Orchestra company, from 2008.
- [Marina Pujadas](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=pedra): Artist and costume designer
- [Jesse Watts](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=jesse-watts): Sound engineer. Pilote de drone, et preneur de son.
- [Paul Brossier](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=paul-brossier): PhD, music developer
- [Thomas Aussenac](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=thomas-aussenac): Sound designer. Composer, Musician, voice over
- [Joan Sandoval](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=joan-sandoval): Creative coder · Barcelona. Creative coding and audio development on Maestro, Peupler, Éphémère and Paysage Sonore.
- [Ben Kuper](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=ben-kuper): Technical director, creative coder. Technical director and coder, inventor of Chataigne, the open-source software that links show control, sensors and media. Creative coding on Peupler.
- [Clément Gamgie Rignault](https://mouawadlaurier.com/handcoded/?p=clement-rignault): Creative coder. Creative coding on Peupler.
